meta.source: SleepSteps brand identity design (PDF, first pass) and the SleepSteps logo (PNG)

tokens.name: deep-teal
tokens.usage: Primary. Hero and header bands, primary buttons, eyebrows, links, completed progress dots, the current step's top rule. Teal fills at least a quarter of every screen. As text: 6.2:1 on `white`, 5.9:1 on `paper`, 5.4:1 on `teal-wash`; on `sand` 4.47:1, so use it there only at 19px bold / 24px and up.

tokens.name: night-teal
tokens.usage: Text on light grounds where a teal voice is wanted (display headings, the video opening frame's ground). 10.5:1 on `paper`, 8.0:1 on `sand`. As a ground, set `paper` on it (10.5:1).

tokens.name: teal-500
tokens.usage: Mid riser of the step mark; the Step 2 thumbnail band; top of the settling arc. Not a text ground for small type: `white` on it is 4.16:1, so text on it sits inside a `paper` chip.

tokens.name: teal-200
tokens.usage: Short riser of the step mark, upcoming step cards' top rule, remaining progress dots. Decorative only: 1.7:1 on `white` (the source's own dot pair; always pair dots with a visible step count).

tokens.name: teal-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted panels, the current step chip, the ground behind the settling arc. Text on it: `ink`, `night-teal` or `deep-teal`.

tokens.name: warm-clay
tokens.usage: Secondary accent, fills only, about one tenth of any layout at most. Never as text on light grounds (3.6:1 on `white`); text on a clay fill is `ink` (4.57:1).

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: The AA text form of clay: tertiary links ("Skip for now", "See the full library"), status chip text. 6.8:1 on `white`, 6.5:1 on `paper`, 5.4:1 on `clay-wash`.

tokens.name: clay-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of the "In progress" status chip. Text on it: `clay-deep`.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm surface: lived-experience thumbnail band, the arc's sun. Text on it: `ink` (11.9:1) or `night-teal`; not `slate-grey` (4.06:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background of the product. Also the text colour on `deep-teal` (5.9:1) and `night-teal` (10.5:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards, video tiles, the header bar and inputs, sitting on `paper`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Notes and rule panels ("Hold the line", alternative pairing). Text on it: `ink`, `slate-grey` (5.1:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, card titles, labels and nav on `paper`, `white`, `panel`, `teal-wash`, `sand` (all 11.9:1 or more). Also the duration badge and footer ground, with `paper` text (15.7:1).

tokens.name: slate-grey
tokens.usage: Secondary text: intros, helper text, metadata under video titles. 5.6:1 on `white`, 5.4:1 on `paper`, 4.9:1 on `teal-wash`.

tokens.name: keyline
tokens.usage: 1px card and tile borders on `white`/`paper`. Decorative separation only (1.3:1); interactive borders use `deep-teal`.

tokens.name: on-teal-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `deep-teal` (hero subline, eyebrow). The source pair is 4.36:1, just under AA for body text: keep it at 17px and up, or set it on `night-teal` (7.8:1).

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: Alternate accent if clay reads too warm. Fills only; text on it `ink` (7.2:1).

tokens.name: dusty-rose
tokens.usage: Alternate accent if clay reads too warm. Fills only; `white` on it is 4.11:1, so large text only.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Alternate accent if clay reads too warm. Fills only; text on it `ink` (7.5:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero statement. Sentence case.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Step card and video tile titles.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes from people with lived experience.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each week has one video, one thing to try, and a place to note what happened.
styles.usage: Running text. 17px is the minimum on the web.

styles.name: body-light
styles.sample: Short videos and small changes you can try tonight.

styles.name: helper
styles.sample: What changed, and why treatment affects rest.
styles.usage: Helper text, card descriptions, video metadata.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings, in `deep-teal` on light grounds. The only uppercase in the system.

styles.name: display-editorial
styles.usage: Optional quieter, more editorial voice: Newsreader headings with Source Sans 3 body. Use instead of Figtree headings for a whole piece, never mixed on one page.

spacing.note: Measured from the brand PDF's layouts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between progress dots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's number disc and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent buttons; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between step cards; tile body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; step card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Duration badges: they square off.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, panels, photography frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Step chips and status pills: always fully rounded.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover only on cards and tiles: the 1px keyline plus a soft teal-tinted shadow. Never a drop shadow at rest. The blur and opacity are a first value; the PDF names the effect, not the numbers.
